U.S. citizen and San Diego resident Isaac Jimenez pleaded guilty June 16 to his role in an alien smuggling conspiracy that held would-be migrants hostage in Mexico.

💰While Jimenez did not personally hold aliens captive, he confessed to collecting tens of thousands of dollars in ransom payments from family members following an ICE @HSISanDiego probe with its California Homeland Security Task Force partners.

In at least two cases — a father of four U.S. citizen children and a young woman from Tijuana — THE VICTIMS DISAPPEARED after their families made multiple ransom payments to secure their freedom.

As part of his guilty plea, Jimenez agreed to pay $24,500 to the family members of the missing migrants for funeral and related expenses and as restitution.

➡️Visit our newsroom for more details in this ongoing case.

Two Venezuelan illegal aliens head to prison for sex trafficking a 16-year-old Venezuelan illegal alien orphan girl in Kentucky and Texas following an ICE @HSI_SanAntonio probe with the San Antonio Police Department and other partners.

Nelson Adrian Perez-Martinez and Giannys Alexandra Ramirez-Fernandez and were sentenced to 20 and 12 ½ years, respectively.

Perez-Martinez illegally crossed the southern border on January 3, 2024, and was released into the country by the Biden administration.

We lodged an immigration detainer on both traffickers and will greet them once they serve the time for their crimes.
